title.en: Electric 40 or Electric 50 for a medium building?
title.zh: 中型建筑选电动40还是电动50？

description.en: Compare 21 m³/h and fine stone 120 m / 360 m on Electric 40 with 26 m³/h and three stone rows on Electric 50. Both need a grid.
description.zh: 对照电动40的 21 m³/h、细石 120 m / 360 m，和电动50的 26 m³/h 及三行石子。两台都要电网。

h1.en: Electric 40 or Electric 50 for a medium building?
h1.zh: 中型建筑选电动40还是电动50？

directAnswer.en: Use Electric 40 when 21 m³/h and its stone rows are enough. Move to Electric 50 when you need the printed 26 m³/h or the 24 mm row. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai puts both on the medium-building question, together with Diesel 40 / Diesel 50 if the grid is missing. Electric 40 fine stone is 120 m / 360 m and aggregate 13 is 40 m / 120 m at 45 kW. Electric 50 fine stone is 150 m / 350 m, 13 mm is 80 m / 240 m and 24 mm is 60 m / 180 m at 55 kW.
directAnswer.zh: 21 m³/h 和它的石子行够用，就停在电动40。需要已印的 26 m³/h 或 24 mm 行，再看电动50。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都放在中型建筑问题上；没有电网则一起看柴油40 / 柴油50。电动40细石 120 m / 360 m，13 骨料 40 m / 120 m，电机 45 kW。电动50细石 150 m / 350 m，13 mm 80 m / 240 m，24 mm 60 m / 180 m，电机 55 kW。

heading.en: The output step is 21 to 26, not a floor step
heading.zh: 输送量从 21 到 26，不是楼层台阶

body.en: Nothing on either page converts that gap into storeys. Weight moves from 2300 kg on Electric 40 to 2800 kg on Electric 50. Hopper volume stays 0.4 m³. Pressure moves from 23 MPa to 30 MPa. Those are catalogue cells for a building pipeline with stable power.
body.zh: 两页都没有把这个差额换成层数。重量从电动40的 2300 kg 到电动50的 2800 kg。料斗都是 0.4 m³。压力从 23 MPa 到 30 MPa。这些是供电稳定的建筑管路目录格。

heading.en: When neither electric row is the start
heading.zh: 什么时候两台电动都不是起点

body.en: No stable grid: open Diesel 40 (66 kW, 26 m³/h, 120 m / 360 m) or Diesel 50 (99 kW, 30 m³/h, 150 m / 450 m). The diesel introductions pair those distances with 1 cm aggregate. Do not paste Electric 50’s 24 mm row onto Diesel 50, which does not print that row.
body.zh: 没有稳定电网：打开柴油40（66 kW、26 m³/h、120 m / 360 m）或柴油50（99 kW、30 m³/h、150 m / 450 m）。柴油产品介绍把这些距离和 1 cm 骨料写在一起。不要把电动50的 24 mm 行贴到没有这一行的柴油50上。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say which stone row you can name, and whether the site can feed 45 kW or 55 kW. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明你能点名的石子行，以及现场能否供应 45 kW 或 55 kW。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Is Electric 50 always the longer vertical pump?
question.zh: 电动50的垂直一定更长吗？

answer.en: Not on every row. Electric 40 fine-stone vertical is 360 m. Electric 50 fine-stone vertical is 350 m. Read the pair, not one number.
answer.zh: 不是每一行都这样。电动40细石垂直是 360 m。电动50细石垂直是 350 m。要读成对的数字，不要只读一个。

question.zh: 两台都印了 13 骨料吗？

answer.en: Electric 40 prints aggregate 13 at 40 m / 120 m. Electric 50 prints a 13 mm row at 80 m / 240 m. Keep the labels as printed.
answer.zh: 电动40的 13 骨料是 40 m / 120 m。电动50的 13 mm 行是 80 m / 240 m。标注保持原文。

question.en: Which page is the selection guide?

answer.en: The medium-building question is on the site selection guide and points at these product paths.
answer.zh: 中型建筑问题在网站选型指南上，并指向这些产品路径。
